dedupe_keys.name: aquarius aquatic informatics commercial environmental water data management and analytics platform

description: Aquarius is a commercial software platform that water monitoring agencies use to acquire, process, model and publish hydrological and water quality data in real time. It is sold by Aquatic Informatics, whose product range also includes the Hach WIMS platform for plant operations and WaterTrax, Tokay and Linko compliance tools. Coverage: a tool, not a dataset; it ingests data from third-party sensors and systems, stores time series and discrete lab and field samples for water, air, soil and biological parameters, and offers rating curves, automated error detection, correction with an audit trail, statistics, maps and dashboards, alerts and the HydroCorrect machine learning module for automated quality control. Format and access: installed software or Aquarius Cloud, a managed software-as-a-service hosted on Amazon Web Services; licensed commercially, with prices not published on the pages read. Licence: proprietary commercial licence. Caveats: the vendor pages are marketing text, no technical documentation or API reference was read, and agency data held in Aquarius is published only where each agency chooses, often through its own web portal. Simulation uses: a common source of quality-controlled river level, flow and rainfall series behind flood warning, stormwater and water supply models used for hazard exposure, emergency response and climate adaptation. Related records: Delft-FEWS (platform-delft-fews) is the open forecasting platform often fed by such monitoring systems.
